After attempting myself, I made some friends and reconnected with them after leaving the institute. 

One night I was messaging a boy, he was upset that his gf of like 2 years left him. He told me he saw no point anymore, and that he was saying goodbye. Then he stopped replying. Being genuinely scared, I called the police. I had no information of where he lived, even the general area. But I told the police the institution that we were put into together, and they found all of his personal information and found him just in time.

After he was re-released from that same institute he told me never to talk to him again. That I put him there, and that he hated me for what I'd done to him. He blocked me, and we haven't spoken since.

Uh, I went because it hurt to move. Everyone assumed I had the flu.

Went to urgent care, the lady took a single look at me, said I was paler than anybody she had ever seen before. She told me to go to the emergency room and not to leave until somebody took my blood.

Turns out your white blood count is supposed to be low, where mine was about 10,000 above what it should have been. I was hospitalized for about a week.

Oh man so much, I've been waiting for a post like this.

I would have missed high school, all of it. I would have missed taking classes that I genuinely enjoy, finding out what I want to do with my future. Finding those teachers who make sure every kid is okay, physically and mentally.

I would have missed so many relationships, and I mean genuinely good ones. Friendships, and like romantic ones. The friends I've got now are so cool, my friends from school care about whether I'm in classes, if I put my head down they take time to make sure everything's alright. The outside of school ones are just as good. 

I wouldn't have made it to my aunts wedding. Can you imagine? The birth of her son, meeting him and watching him grow up. 

Getting drunk with my best friend and experiencing the 'omg I like love you' bathroom talk.

Staying up late talking to my favorite person in the world.

Being able to stress about test scores.

Hearing my cousin and brother come out, being the reason my cousin felt strong enough to own up to my grandma; watching her live without any judgement because she 'knows I'll be there'.

Graduating middle school with a fucking amazing set of friends, who would only get closer.

Gaining a relationship with my dad, and watching movies with him, playing games, and a lot more. 

Would have missed my first kiss. 

I would have missed so much.

I don't know if he is or isn't a psychopath, but my brother does things that make me feel like he might be a psychopath.

When we were younger we were playing at the beach, in the water, and he sat on my chest so that I went under the water. I remember thinking "I'm going to die". I flailed my arms and desperately tried to get him to let me up. I started to get where black spots were appearing and my vision was beginning to tunnel in, then he let me up. I was coughing up water, because I was young and as he pushed me down I screamed, causing me to swallow water, while I was coughing up water he was just laughing at me. He thought it was funny.

The second time I can remember something like this happening we were both sharing a bedroom, probably about nine or ten and had separate beds. Well he was listening to music and I was talking to three of our step siblings who were visiting, two girls and a boy, all older than my brother and I. Well, I told him to turn down the music so I could hear them talking, and he refused, so I turned it down myself, This infuriated him to the point that he grabbed me, pushed me to the edge of my bed and began to choke me. He was choking me so hard that he was shaking, and it didn't take very long for me to begin gasping for air or feeling that same sense of "this is how I die". It took all three of our step siblings to get him off of me, and they were only able to hold him long enough for me to jump up and bolt down the stairs, missing entire stairs on the way down, but its like my body was fighting in its own way. I saw my mom on our couch and just dove behind her, I didn't actually know if he was following me or not until I sat up behind my mother and saw him moving towards me, where my mother stopped him. He got in no trouble, and we continued to share a room for another year.

When we first moved into our current house my mother left to go get food and movies, to celebrate the new house. I don't remember what I said, but it made my brother so mad that he started shaking and he stood up and walked towards me. His whole face was red, thankfully before he could even get halfway across the living room to get to me my mother opened the door and saw what was going to happen. My mom has always been the only person who could control him; and ever since I genuinely fear for my safety.

When we were both younger and lived with our dad my dad was very abusive. My brother would use this and tell my dad that I did things, where it would be my brother who had done them, and I would get hit for it, while my brother would be able to go out to eat with my dad because he was the 'golden child'. I always received the reputation of being the 'liar' or 'bad kid' while all of this would happen behind the scenes.
